answer: Because the custody account is separate, someone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 72 aliases, and each one needs its own funded pearl account. Deposits are visible in karst, and relic reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 59% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. A farm of 3460 identities would post 818 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
